summary.text: Tom Dippel is a Republican state representative from House District 41B, in office since January 2025, who is the Republican candidate for Minnesota Senate District 41 in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Tom Dippel earned a high school diploma from Park High School.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as owning a dental business.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as married with six children and the owner of a small medical manufacturing business with 20 employees.
Dippel took office in the Minnesota House on January 14, 2025, succeeding Shane Hudella, and is not running for re-election to that seat in 2026.

In the 2022 survey, he listed lower taxes and less regulation on business, support for law enforcement and the criminal justice system, and a return to the fundamentals of education among his campaign messages.
